evidence_level: offline file-backed code; no actual-game or headset check

inherited.treatment: Immutable predecessor. Its child ownership remains valid; this proof refines the previously incomplete argument list and scalar-accessor description.

scope.stop_reason: Exact branch produces a queue submission; neither transform composition nor its selected-view consumer is reached. Stop at this ownership boundary instead of spending remaining budget on unrelated child internals.
scope.strategy: Exact direct edges only; one-instruction dumpbin reads stop at returns/unconditional branches; explicit in-unit branch continuation completes coverage. No whole-image code or xref scan.

abi.original: 0x39cd30 receives (A, B, C); A is incoming scalar; types of B/C beyond this flow are not independently established.
abi.local_matrix: M is the existing stack identity matrix, optionally filled by resolved companion+0x88 owner virtual+0x44. It is distinct storage from companion relative+0x90..+0xc8 and base+0x10..+0x48.
abi.scalar_accessor: T=0x2ca490([TLS+0x0c]); zero stack arguments. If byte+0x28 is set, return double+0x20 rounded to float; otherwise return unsigned dword+0 divided by unsigned dword+4, rounded to float. No matrix or caller scalar is read.

findings.child_state: 0x41e590 drains child pending entries via undecoded0x40ff80 and resets the end pointer. When child+0x84 is nonzero and descriptors exist, it stores A/T into the indexed float array reached through child+0x58 using child+0x64/+0x60 descriptors. Descriptor semantics are unproved.
findings.submission: 0x41e610 then calls0xb50630 with ECX=B. That leaf helper increments B+0x720 and writes R=[B]+old_count*0x70. R+0x00,+04,+08,+10,+14,+18,+20,+24,+28,+30,+34,+38 copy M; R+0x40=[child+0x54], +0x44=0.0f, +0x48=-1.0f, +0x4d=0, +0x50=0, +0x54=-1. Remaining record fields are untouched by this helper.
findings.ownership_limit: This proves a constructor-owned child state update and matrix/state submission, not an evaluated transform output. No decoded new function composes companion relative+0x90..+0xc8 with base+0x10..+0x48. The queued record consumer and concrete B ownership are unknown; deeper effects of pending-entry helper0x40ff80 are unexamined.
findings.acceptance_limit: No selected local-player view, active camera, HUD, cutscene entry/skip/exit or gameplay-return authority is proved. No source fix or continuous head-rotation override is supported.
findings.prior_negative: Manager membership and its inherited false gate were not retraced or promoted into active-camera evidence.

next_unresolved_edge.unresolved: Consumer of this exact submitted record -> evaluated transform output -> selected local-player view. Consumer target is not identified; no new call target is invented.
next_unresolved_edge.required: Identify an explicit consumer/owner before any further queue or child expansion; queue scheduling alone cannot establish camera ownership.
